title.lg: Sitampu ya LC1 mu Mukono: UGX 10,000

answer.en: In Mukono, the LC1 stamp on your documents costs a flat 10,000 UGX under Mukono by-laws. Never a percentage. Pay at your village LC1 office and get a receipt.
answer.lg: Mu Mukono, sitampu ya LC1 ku bbaluwa zo ya UGX 10,000 zokka ng'amateeka ga Mukono bwe galagira. Si kitundu ku muwendo. Sasira ku offiisi ya LC1 mu kyalo kyo era ofune risiti.
answer.sw: Mukono, muhuri wa LC1 kwenye nyaraka zako ni UGX 10,000 taslimu chini ya sheria ndogo za Mukono. Kamwe si asilimia. Lipia ofisi ya LC1 kijijini kwako na upate risiti.

legal_citation: Mukono District By-Laws; Local Government (Fees) Regulations

illegal_practices.en: Any LC1 in Mukono charging more than 10,000 UGX for the stamp is breaking the by-laws. Report to LC2 or the sub-county office.
illegal_practices.lg: LC1 yonna mu Mukono esasula ennyo okusinga UGX 10,000 ku sitampu emenya amateeka. Gitegeeze ku LC2 oba ku offiisi ya ggombolola.
illegal_practices.sw: LC1 yoyote Mukono inayotoza zaidi ya UGX 10,000 kwa muhuri inavunja sheria ndogo. Iripoti kwa LC2 au ofisi ya tarafa.

en: Bring your signed document to the LC1 office
Pay exactly 10,000 UGX and get a receipt
Confirm the stamp shows the village name and date
lg: Leeta ebbaluwa yo eriko omukono ku offiisi ya LC1
Sasula UGX 10,000 zokka era ofune risiti
Kakasa nti sitampu eriko erinnya ly'ekyalo n'olunaku
sw: Leta waraka wako uliosainiwa ofisi ya LC1
Lipa UGX 10,000 kamili na upate risiti
Hakikisha muhuri una jina la kijiji na tarehe

question.en: Did you know? The LC1 stamp fee is 10,000 UGX by law. If you are asked to pay more, it is not legal.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Ssente za sitampu ya LC1 UGX 10,000 ng'etteeka bwe ligamba. Bw'osabibwa osasule ennyo, tekiri mu mateeka.
question.sw: Ulijua? Ada ya muhuri wa LC1 ni UGX 10,000 kisheria. Ukidaiwa kulipa zaidi, si halali.

answer.en: True in Mukono too. Flat 10,000 UGX under district by-laws.
answer.lg: Mazima ne mu Mukono. UGX 10,000 nnyiriri ng'amateeka ga disitulikiti bwe galagira.
answer.sw: Kweli hata Mukono. UGX 10,000 taslimu chini ya sheria ndogo za wilaya.

title.lg: Ebbaluwa ya LC1 mu Mukono: YA BWEREERE
title.sw: Barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 Mukono: BURE

answer.en: In Mukono, the LC1 introductory letter costs 0 UGX. Free by law. Take your ID to your village LC1 office and collect it the same day.
answer.lg: Mu Mukono, ebbaluwa ya LC1 eya kwanjula ya UGX 0. Ya bwereere ng'etteeka bwe ligamba. Twala ID yo ku offiisi ya LC1 mu kyalo kyo era oggye olunaku olwo.
answer.sw: Mukono, barua ya utambulisho ya LC1 ni UGX 0. Ni bure kisheria. Peleka kitambulisho chako ofisi ya LC1 kijijini kwako na ichukue siku hiyo hiyo.

legal_citation: Mukono District By-Laws; Local Government (Fees) Regulations

illegal_practices.en: Charging for this letter in Mukono is illegal. Report fee demands to LC2 or the sub-county office.
illegal_practices.lg: Okusasuza ku bbaluwa eno mu Mukono kimenya mateeka. Abasaba ssente bategeeze ku LC2 oba ku offiisi ya ggombolola.
illegal_practices.sw: Kutoza kwa barua hii Mukono ni kinyume cha sheria. Ripoti wanaodai pesa kwa LC2 au ofisi ya tarafa.

en: Go to your LC1 office with your ID
State what the letter is for (passport, NIRA, job)
Collect it free the same day
lg: Genda ku offiisi ya LC1 yo ng'olina ID yo
Tegeeza ky'ogenda okukozesa ebbaluwa (pasipooti, NIRA, mulimu)
sw: Nenda ofisi yako ya LC1 na kitambulisho chako
Eleza barua ni ya nini (pasipoti, NIRA, kazi)

question.en: Did you know? The Mukono LC1 letter is free and ready same day.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Ebbaluwa ya LC1 mu Mukono ya bwereere era ngyetegefu olunaku olwo.
question.sw: Ulijua? Barua ya LC1 Mukono ni bure na tayari siku hiyo hiyo.

answer.en: Yes. 0 UGX. Carry your ID to the LC1 office.
answer.lg: Yee. UGX 0. Twala ID yo ku offiisi ya LC1.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. UGX 0. Beba kitambulisho chako ofisi ya LC1.

title.en: Customary boundary dispute in Mukono: LC1 first
title.lg: Enjawulo y'ensalo ez'obutonde mu Mukono: LC1 esooka
title.sw: Mgogoro wa mpaka ya kimila Mukono: LC1 kwanza

answer.en: For customary land boundary fights in Mukono, go to your LC1 Civil Court first. NOT the Police. Bring elders who know the old boundaries. The hearing happens on the land itself.
answer.lg: Ku ntalo z'ensalo z'ettaka ery'obutonde mu Mukono, sooka ogende mu kkooti ya LC1 yo. SI ku Poliisi. Leeta abakadde abamanyi ensalo enkadde. Okuwulira kubeera ku ttaka lyennyini.
answer.sw: Kwa mapigano ya mipaka ya ardhi ya kimila Mukono, anza Mahakama ya LC1 yako. SI Polisi. Leta wazee wanaojua mipaka ya zamani. Usikilizaji hufanyika kwenye ardhi yenyewe.

illegal_practices.en: Police cannot decide who owns customary land. Officers demanding money for boundary cases are breaking the law. Report to the District Police Commander.
illegal_practices.lg: Poliisi teyinza kusalawo nannyini ttaka ery'obutonde. Abaserikale abasaba ssente ku misango gy'ensalo bamenya mateeka. Bategeeze ku District Police Commander.
illegal_practices.sw: Polisi haiwezi kuamua nani mmiliki wa ardhi ya kimila. Maafisa wanaodai pesa kwa kesi za mipaka wanavunja sheria. Waripoti kwa Kamanda wa Polisi wa Wilaya.

en: Talk to the elders who know the old boundary
File the case at your LC1 Civil Court
Attend the on-land hearing with your witnesses
lg: Ggulawo omusango mu kkooti ya LC1 yo
Genda mu kuwulira okubeera ku ttaka ng'olina abajulizi bo
sw: Ongea na wazee wanaojua mpaka wa zamani
Fungua shauri Mahakama ya LC1 yako
Hudhuria usikilizaji unaofanyika ardhini na mashahidi wako

question.en: Did you know? Mukono customary boundary cases start at LC1, free.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Emisango gy'ensalo ez'obutonde mu Mukono gitandikira ku LC1, kwa bwereere.
question.sw: Ulijua? Kesi za mipaka ya kimila Mukono huanzia LC1, bure.

answer.en: Yes. Not Police. Bring elders who know the old boundary.
answer.lg: Yee. Si Poliisi. Leeta abakadde abamanyi ensalo enkadde.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Si Polisi. Leta wazee wanaojua mpaka wa zamani.

title.en: Mailo land dispute in Mukono: Land Board
title.lg: Enjawulo y'ettaka lya mailo mu Mukono: Land Board
title.sw: Mgogoro wa ardhi ya mailo Mukono: Bodi ya Ardhi

answer.en: For mailo land disputes in Mukono, go to the Mukono District Land Board. NOT LC1. LC1 has no power over mailo land. Carry your title copy or tenancy papers. Mukono has many mailo-bibanja tensions, so use the official channel.
answer.lg: Ku enjawulo z'ettaka lya mailo mu Mukono, genda ku Mukono District Land Board. SI ku LC1. LC1 terina buyinza ku ttaka lya mailo. Twala koppi ya title oba ebbaluwa zo ez'obupangisa. Mu Mukono mulimu enkaayana nnyingi eza mailo-bibanja, kale kozesa ekkubo entuufu.
answer.sw: Kwa migogoro ya ardhi ya mailo Mukono, nenda Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya ya Mukono. SI LC1. LC1 haina mamlaka juu ya ardhi ya mailo. Beba nakala ya hati au karatasi zako za upanga. Mukono ina mvutano mingi ya mailo-bibanja, kwa hivyo tumia njia rasmi.

illegal_practices.en: Landlords may not evict bibanja holders by force or with armed men. Forced evictions are criminal. Call Police on 112 and report to the Land Board.
illegal_practices.lg: Bannannyini mailo tebakirizibwa kugoba bapangisa na maanyi oba n'abasirikale. Okugoba n'amaanyi musango. Kubira Poliisi ku 112 era otegeeze ku Land Board.
illegal_practices.sw: Mabwana ardhi hawaruhusiwi kuwafukuza wapangaji kwa nguvu au na watu wenye silaha. Kufukuza kwa nguvu ni jinai. Pigia Polisi kwa 112 na uripoti kwa Bodi ya Ardhi.

en: Copy your title or tenancy papers and keep originals safe
File your complaint at the Mukono District Land Board
Never sign eviction papers without a lawyer or FIDA
lg: Koppiya title oba ebbaluwa zo ez'obupangisa era okwate entuufu
Ggulawo okwemulugunya kwo ku Mukono District Land Board
Tossa mukono ku bbaluwa z'okugobwa nga tolina munnamateeka oba FIDA
sw: Nakili hati yako au karatasi za upanga na uhifadhi halisi
Fungua malalamiko yako Bodi ya Ardhi ya Wilaya ya Mukono
Usisaini karatasi za kufukuzwa bila wakili au FIDA

question.en: Did you know? Mailo fights in Mukono go to the Land Board, not LC1.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Entalo za mailo mu Mukono zigenda ku Land Board, si ku LC1.
question.sw: Ulijua? Mapigano ya mailo Mukono huenda Bodi ya Ardhi, si LC1.

answer.en: Yes. And forced evictions are criminal. Call 112.
answer.lg: Yee. Era okugoba n'amaanyi musango. Kubira 112.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Na kufukuza kwa nguvu ni jinai. Pigia 112.

title.en: Widow evicted in Mukono: your rights
title.lg: Nnamwandu agobwa mu Mukono: eddembe lyo

answer.en: In Mukono, a widow threatened with eviction is protected by the Succession Amendment Act 2022. Go to LC1 first, then to the District Court if needed. FIDA gives free lawyers to women. Do not leave the home under threats.
answer.lg: Mu Mukono, nnamwandu atisibwatiisibwa okugobwa akuumibwa etteeka lya Succession Amendment Act 2022. Sooka ogende ku LC1, oluvannyuma ogende mu kkooti ya disitulikiti bwe kiba kyetaagisa. FIDA ewa bannamateeka ba bwereere eri abakyala. Tova mu nnyumba olw'okutisatiisibwa.
answer.sw: Mukono, mjane anayetishiwa kufukuzwa analindwa na Succession Amendment Act 2022. Anza kwenda LC1, kisha Mahakama ya Wilaya ikihitajika. FIDA hutoa mawakili wa bure kwa wanawake. Usiondoke nyumbani kwa vitisho.

correct_authority: LC1, then Mukono District Court + FIDA

illegal_practices.en: Chasing a widow or selling her home without court authority is a crime in Mukono as everywhere. Call 112 if threatened and keep all documents safe.
illegal_practices.lg: Okugoba nnamwandu oba okutunda ennyumba ye nga tolina buyinza bwa kkooti musango mu Mukono nga bwe kiri wonna. Kubira 112 bw'otisibwatiisibwa era okwate ebbaluwa zonna.
illegal_practices.sw: Kumfukuza mjane au kuuza nyumba yake bila mamlaka ya mahakama ni jinai Mukono kama kote. Pigia 112 ukitishiwa na uhifadhi nyaraka zote.

en: Stay put and keep death certificate and marriage proof
Report to your LC1 and get written protection
Take the papers to FIDA or Mukono court
lg: Sigalawo era okwate death certificate n'obujulizi bw'obufumbo
Tegeeza ku LC1 yo era ofune okuwataakibwa mu buwandiike
Twala ebbaluwa eri FIDA oba mu kkooti ya Mukono
sw: Kaa hapo na uhifadhi cheti cha kifo na uthibitisho wa ndoa
Ripoti kwa LC1 yako na upate ulinzi ulioandikwa
Peleka karatasi kwa FIDA au mahakama ya Mukono

question.en: Did you know? A Mukono widow keeps her home and her share by law.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Nnamwandu mu Mukono akuuma ennyumba ye n'ekitundu kye ng'etteeka bwe ligamba.
question.sw: Ulijua? Mjane wa Mukono hubaki na nyumba yake na sehemu yake kisheria.

answer.en: Yes. Section 7 of the 2022 amendments. FIDA lawyers are free.
answer.lg: Yee. Section 7 ey'ennongoosereza za 2022. Bannamateeka ba FIDA ba bwereere.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Kifungu cha 7 cha marekebisho ya 2022. Mawakili wa FIDA ni bure.

title.en: Domestic violence: go to Police, NOT LC1
title.lg: Okukuba mu maka: genda ku Poliisi, SI ku LC1
title.sw: Ukatili wa nyumbani: nenda Polisi, SI LC1

answer.en: If someone beats or threatens you at home in Mukono, do NOT go to LC1. Go straight to the Police Child and Family Protection Unit (CFPU) or call 112. It is free and urgent cases are handled day and night. FIDA also helps women for free.
answer.lg: Omuntu bw'akukuba oba akutisatiisa awaka mu Mukono, TOGENDA ku LC1. Genda butereevu ku Poliisi mu kitongole kya CFPU oba okubire 112. Kwa bwereere era emisango egy'amangu gikwatibwa emisana n'ekiro. FIDA nayo eyamba abakyala kwa bwereere.
answer.sw: Mtu akikupiga au kukutishia nyumbani Mukono, USIENDE kwa LC1. Nenda moja kwa moja Polisi Kitengo cha Ulinzi wa Mtoto na Familia (CFPU) au pigia 112. Ni bure na kesi za dharura hushughulikiwa mchana na usiku. FIDA pia huwasaidia wanawake bure.

legal_citation: Domestic Violence Act 2010; Penal Code Act

illegal_practices.en: No LC1, elder or relative may force you to forgive violence or withdraw a police case. Forcing reconciliation is itself abuse. Stay safe first.
illegal_practices.lg: Tewali LC1, mukadde oba ow'oluganda akkirizibwa kukuwaliriza kusonyiwa okukubibwa oba okuggyawo omusango ku Poliisi. Okukuwaliriza okutabagana nakwo kutulugunya. Sooka obeere mirembe.
illegal_practices.sw: Hakuna LC1, mzee au ndugu anayeruhusiwa kukulazimisha kusamehe ukatili au kufuta kesi polisi. Kulazimisha upatanisho wenyewe ni unyanyasaji. Anza kuwa salama.

en: Get to safety first: neighbour, friend or police post
Report to Police CFPU or call 112 and get a reference number
Ask for medical form PF3 and keep hospital records
lg: Soooka obeere mu kifo eky'emirembe: muliraanwa, mukwano oba poliisi
Tegeeza ku CFPU ya Poliisi oba okubire 112 era ofune namba ya fayiro
Saba foomu y'obujjanjabi PF3 era okwate ebbaluwa z'eddwaaliro
sw: Anza fika mahali salama: jirani, rafiki au kituo cha polisi
Ripoti CFPU ya Polisi au pigia 112 na upate namba ya kumbukumbu
Omba fomu ya matibabu PF3 na uhifadhi rekodi za hospitali

question.en: Did you know? Beating at home is a police case, not an LC1 matter.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Okukuba awaka musango gwa Poliisi, si gwa LC1.
question.sw: Ulijua? Kupigwa nyumbani ni kesi ya polisi, si ya LC1.

answer.en: Yes. Go to Police CFPU or call 112, day or night.
answer.lg: Yee. Genda ku CFPU ya Poliisi oba okubire 112, emisana oba ekiro.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Nenda CFPU ya Polisi au pigia 112, mchana au usiku.

title.lg: Okwegatta ku NWSC mu Mukono: UGX 250,000

answer.en: A new NWSC water connection in Mukono costs 250,000 UGX, paid officially at the Mukono Town Centre office. Bring your ID, LC1 letter and a sketch of your plot. Keep the receipt. Anyone offering cheaper backdoor connections is a fraudster.
answer.lg: Okwegatta ku mazzi ga NWSC omulundi ogusooka mu Mukono kwa UGX 250,000, ezisasulwa mu ngeri entuufu ku offiisi eri mu Mukono Town Centre. Leeta ID yo, ebbaluwa ya LC1 n'akapande k'ekitundu kyo. Kwata risiti. Asuubiza okukwegatta ku bbusungu ly'emiryango emabega mufere.
answer.sw: Kuunganishwa mpya kwa maji ya NWSC Mukono ni UGX 250,000, zinazolipwa rasmi ofisi iliyo Mukono Town Centre. Leta kitambulisho chako, barua ya LC1 na mchoro wa kiwanja chako. Hifadhi risiti. Anayeahidi kukuunganisha kwa njia za nyuma ni tapeli.

legal_citation: Water Act Cap 152; NWSC tariff schedule

illegal_practices.en: Backdoor connections are illegal and NWSC removes them without refund, plus a fine. Pay only at the NWSC office with a receipt.
illegal_practices.lg: Okwegatta mu ngeri ey'ekyama kimenya mateeka era NWSC ekiggyako nga tewaliako kuzza ssente, wamu n'engassi. Sasula kwokka ku offiisi ya NWSC ng'ofuna risiti.
illegal_practices.sw: Miunganisho ya nyuma ni haramu na NWSC huyiondoa bila kurejesha pesa, pamoja na faini. Lipa tu ofisi ya NWSC na upate risiti.

en: Get your ID, LC1 letter and plot sketch ready
Apply at NWSC Mukono Town Centre office
Pay 250,000 UGX officially and keep the receipt until connected
lg: Tegeka ID yo, ebbaluwa ya LC1 n'akapande k'ekitundu
Saba ku offiisi ya NWSC mu Mukono Town Centre
Sasula UGX 250,000 mu ngeri entuufu era okwate risiti okutu lw'okwegattibwa
sw: Andaa kitambulisho chako, barua ya LC1 na mchoro wa kiwanja
Omba ofisi ya NWSC Mukono Town Centre
Lipa UGX 250,000 rasmi na uhifadhi risiti hadi uunganishwe

question.en: Did you know? A new NWSC connection in Mukono is 250,000 UGX at the office.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Okwegatta ku NWSC omulundi ogusooka mu Mukono kwa UGX 250,000 ku offiisi.
question.sw: Ulijua? Kuunganishwa mpya NWSC Mukono ni UGX 250,000 ofisini.

answer.en: Yes. ID, LC1 letter and plot sketch. No backdoor deals.
answer.lg: Yee. ID, ebbaluwa ya LC1 n'akapande k'ekitundu. Tewali ntegeka za kyama.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Kitambulisho, barua ya LC1 na mchoro wa kiwanja. Hakuna dili za nyuma.

title.lg: Ensimbi za bizinensi entono mu Mukono: UGX 500,000
title.sw: Ruzuku ya biashara ndogo Mukono: UGX 500,000

answer.en: Mukono District offers a 500,000 UGX small business grant for residents with registered businesses under 2 years old. Apply free at the District Industrial Development Department with your ID, business registration and LC1 letter. Nobody may charge you to access the form.
answer.lg: Disitulikiti y'e Mukono ewa ensimbi UGX 500,000 ez'okuyamba bizinensi entono eri abatuuze abalina bizinensi ezawandiisibwa ezitakka myaka 2. Saba kwa bwereere ku Department y'eby'amakolero eya disitulikiti ng'olina ID yo, ebbaluwa y'okuwandiisa bizinensi n'ebbaluwa ya LC1. Tewali akkirizibwa kukusasuza okufuna foomu.
answer.sw: Wilaya ya Mukono hutoa ruzuku ya UGX 500,000 kwa biashara ndogo kwa wakazi wenye biashara zilizosajiliwa chini ya miaka 2. Omba bure Idara ya Maendeleo ya Viwanda ya Wilaya ukiwa na kitambulisho chako, usajili wa biashara na barua ya LC1. Hakuna anayeruhusiwa kukutoza kupata fomu.

illegal_practices.en: Anyone demanding a percentage of your grant to approve it is corrupt. Forms and applications are free. Report them to the District office or Police.
illegal_practices.lg: Asaba ekitundu ku nsimbi zo okuzikiriza mulya ssente za gavumenti. Foomu n'okusaba kwa bwereere. Bategeeze ku offiisi ya disitulikiti oba ku Poliisi.
illegal_practices.sw: Anayedai asilimia ya ruzuku yako kuidhinisha ni mla rushwa. Fomu na maombi ni bure. Waripoti kwa ofisi ya wilaya au Polisi.

en: Register your business if not yet registered
Collect ID, registration papers and LC1 letter
Submit the free form at the Industrial Development Department
lg: Kuŋŋaanya ID yo, ebbaluwa z'okuwandiisa n'ebbaluwa ya LC1
Twaayo foomu ya bwereere ku Department y'eby'amakolero
sw: Kusanya kitambulisho chako, karatasi za usajili na barua ya LC1
Wasilisha fomu ya bure Idara ya Maendeleo ya Viwanda

question.en: Did you know? Mukono gives 500,000 UGX grants to young registered businesses.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Mukono ewa UGX 500,000 eri bizinensi ento ezawandiisibwa.
question.sw: Ulijua? Mukono hutoa ruzuku ya UGX 500,000 kwa biashara changa zilizosajiliwa.

answer.en: Yes. Forms are free. Never pay anyone a cut of your grant.
answer.lg: Yee. Foomu za bwereere. Tosasa muntu yenna kitundu ku nsimbi zo.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Fomu ni bure. Usimlipe mtu yeyote sehemu ya ruzuku yako.
